concept.title: A community meal or somewhere to eat with others
concept.shortdesc: As someone who eats alone or has little money, I need a community meal or lunch club, so that I eat well and have company.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-025). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: older people, people on low incomes.
Situation: Different from a food bank: open access, timing, company.
A good result: Meals and lunch clubs with day, time, cost and whether to book.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: free hot meal and a chat

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
